title: EMV Chip Cards — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: EMV chips create a unique transaction code for each payment, defeating simple card cloning. Chip verification replaced magnetic-stripe swipes across most markets. This overview edition presents EMV Chip Cards as a core cards concept in modern banking.

spec.how_it_works: Cards authorize against a credit line or deposit balance, clear in batches, and settle between issuing and acquiring banks.
spec.real_world_use: Global: The United States completed its EMV liability shift in 2015.
spec.risk_notes: Standard controls apply: verification, monitoring, reconciliation, and documented compliance procedures.
spec.typical_costs: Costs vary by institution and usage; compare published fee schedules and compute effective cost under realistic volumes.
spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
